Team—

Quick summary: Nimbus Analytics is in the final evaluation week of a 30-day trial. The product team has flagged production-readiness and wants to commit, but their procurement timeline will slip past the quarter unless we provide a short-term usage buffer. They’re at ~70% of a planned 3-month usage profile but need headroom to exercise inference at scale during their final benchmarks.

Ask: can we approve a short-term, conditional credit pool to accelerate close? Proposed terms (internal):
- $12,000 platform credit (applies to token generation only)
- Valid for 30 days from acceptance
- Drawn down only after a signed PO or an explicit written intent-to-purchase from Nimbus
- Monthly cap $8,000 after trial; remaining credit forfeits unless they convert

I’ve attached the internal approval sheet with deal math and forecast (internal_approval_sheet.xlsx). If we can get sign-off by EOD today, I will issue the customer-facing PDF and route to procurement. Prefer a short yes/no and any constraints you want added.

Thanks—
Alex
